notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: one left drawer, two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors, and one right drawer. The two cabinet-door closures occur within the same short sampled interval, so their individual off times are approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens the two hinged cabinet doors above the cooktop and later closes them, and finally opens and closes the upper utensil drawer right of the stove.
